title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Mixtape. Keep it, take an alternate, re-roll, or take the standard.

options.label: The Mixtape
options.lineage: hand-lettered cassette J-cards, timed to fill a side
options.thesis: The year is a box of mixtapes: every topic a tape, every lesson a track, and the tape is wound to exactly where the class is up to.
options.viewport: A shelf of term tapes spine-out; the current tape pulled forward with its J-card unfolded, the tracklist ruled in ballpoint, and the position marker inked beside the lesson the class is up to.
options.risk: Reads as the teacher's nostalgia rather than the students' world if the object stays precious instead of playful.

options.label: Marker Zine
options.lineage: hand-drawn technical zines and annotated napkin diagrams
options.thesis: Every lesson reads like a mate's brilliant annotated notes: marker headings, doodle arrows, highlighter on the one line that matters.
options.viewport: A marker-lettered lesson title over a doodled listening diagram, arrows looping from call-out to task, a highlighter swipe marking where the class is up to.
options.case: Fuses well: lessons genuinely read better as sketched explanations, and the energy suits the brief. The honest risk is skewing younger than Year 10.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The term is a visible construction grid: monumental letterforms built cell by cell, one cell lit for where the class is.
options.viewport: Enormous grid-built numerals for the lesson number over faint graph-paper hairlines, the week strip running beneath with one cell filled.
options.case: Striking and disciplined, and the sequence grammar carries position cleanly, but it is cold: audience identification is its weak axis for 15-year-olds.

options.label: Fold Sequence
options.lineage: an orizuru crane folded in thirty-two numbered steps
options.thesis: The term as one continuous sheet folded step by step: thirty lessons as numbered folds, a gold dot on the active one.
options.viewport: A square vermilion sheet mid-fold, the numbered step column in a strict margin, the gold dot sitting on the current lesson's fold.
options.case: Its step-sequence grammar maps perfectly to 30 lessons, but the washi world fuses poorly with a music classroom: there is no cultural bridge for this audience.

canonCard.label: The school course site
canonCard.thesis: The familiar Bitesize/Khan arrangement, executed at full craft: card grids, breadcrumbs, colour-coded courses.
canonCard.viewport: A clean hero, a three-up grid of lesson cards, an amber position panel. What is built today, polished further.
